description: This Java source file defines a class `TaskBackService` that extends `AccessibilityService`. It demonstrates how an accessibility service can query window content, respond to accessibility events, and use Text-To-Speech (TTS) to provide feedback based on UI interactions, particularly within a list view component.

classes.name: TaskBackService
classes.description: An accessibility service that traverses UI elements and provides spoken feedback using Text-To-Speech, primarily for managing task list items.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes the TTS engine when the service connects.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Handles accessibility events, retrieves relevant UI nodes, and constructs speech output based on task completion status.

methods.name: getListItemNodeInfo
methods.description: Traverses upwards in the view hierarchy to find the list item node info for a given source.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling service interruptions.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Called when TTS engine initialization completes; sets language and updates initialization flag.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases TTS resources when the service is destroyed.
